about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Aspiring Full Stack Developer & Year 2 MIS Student
about.description: I am a Year 2, Semester 2 student majoring in Management Information Systems (MIS) at SETEC Institute, where I also studied UI/UX design fundamentals for a semester as part of my curriculum. With practical technical training from Simpaz Center and an intensive Full Stack Web Development bootcamp at TFD, my primary ambition is to become a skilled Full Stack Developer. I build modern web applications using Vue, React, and Angular on the frontend, supported by reliable backend architectures using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and modern DevOps tools.
about.comp_frontend_desc: Building responsive, modern UIs with Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Angular, React, and TypeScript.
about.comp_backend_desc: Architecting RESTful APIs with Node.js, Express, MongoDB & Mongoose, MySQL, and JWT authentication.
about.comp_uiux_desc: Designing clean prototypes, wireframes, and user flows in Figma learned through my MIS UI/UX course.
about.comp_perf_desc: Docker containerization, Postman API testing, Git & GitHub workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
